| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| [Data Citation Corpus (DCC)]{#gls-dcc} | A collection of scholarly publications and their associated data citations. |
| [Data Availability Statement (DAS)]{#gls-das} | A statement describing whether and how the data supporting an article can be accessed. |
